name: Cala Presili
description: A small virgin cove next to Cala Tortuga, at the foot of the Favàritx Lighthouse within the natural park. It is usually combined with Tortuga on the same walk, its quiet assured by controlled access.

highlights: the wild swim at the foot of the Favàritx lighthouse
combining it with Cala Tortuga, its neighbour, on the same day
in summer reached by seasonal bus, not by car

imageAlt: The rocky shore beside Favàritx lighthouse, with Cala Presili and Platja de Tortuga beyond
imageCredit: carlos venegas gavilán / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)

practicalInfo.aparcamiento: From 1 June to 30 September you cannot arrive by car or motorbike: the whole Favàritx lighthouse area is closed to private traffic and you go in by bus. From 1 June 2026 the Favàritx bus runs twelve times a day, four more than last year. From the stop it is about a 15-minute walk.
practicalInfo.mejorEpoca: Outside the restricted season (October to May) you can drive to the lighthouse car park and the beach is all but empty. In summer, take the first bus of the morning.
